g.text: Chat lore — materialized once, sent once
(spec: flows.spec.ts · "LLM synchronization — excludeFromContext flag in the request builder")
1. Nobody has to write the lore into the thread
2. Before a direction is sent, one lore node is materialized
[the direction already has a lore node as parent]
3. The send sees the lore, the chat does not change
4. After a real send the lore node is deactivated
5. The next direction gets a fresh node
6. Regenerate / rewrite / insert re-arm the shared lore
